abstract: Acute rheumatic fever (ARF) results from an autoimmune response to Streptococcus pyogenes (group A Streptococcus) pharyngitis. ARF leads to rheumatic heart disease (RHD), the most common acquired heart disease in children and young adults globally. Pathogenesis involves molecular mimicry between group A streptococcal M protein and cardiac tissues.
title: Acute rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease
